# Teja (tejalogs)

> AI Content Strategist, Growth Architect, and Software Developer based in Vijayawada, India.

Teja — full name Sai Teja, online handle tejalogs — is an AI Content Strategist and Digital Marketer who is also a self-made software developer. He pairs growth strategy with engineering: he doesn't just design blueprints for digital growth, he builds the autonomous engines that execute them. His work sits at the intersection of human psychology, LLM systems, and agentic automation.
